Why notification systems are a nightmare for engineers

Every notification system starts the same way. Someone files a ticket: send a receipt email when someone places an order. Say you work at Halden, an online shop that sells lamps. You've got an email provider and an API key, and ten minutes later checkout does this:

Ana in Lisbon orders a lamp (order #8812), the receipt shows up in her inbox, you close the ticket and go get lunch. Easy.
